lead: `Core\Config::set('limits.memory', '1')` is accepted and ends the request on the spot
body: , because a request lowering its own budget is always allowed and one byte is a ceiling the next allocation passes. An attack that churns a budget down to its smallest accepted value therefore fatals at round zero, and every section under it never runs while the case still reports as a pass — a clean fatal is one. Churn between values the program still fits in, and put the deliberate exhaustion last.
